name: vigor
description: A confidential front door for male reproductive health: early explainable risk identification and safe routing to care.

scripts._comment_reload: Re-import and re-activate after editing workflows. n8n must restart to pick up activation changes.
scripts.stack:reload: npm run workflows:build && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm n8n-init && docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml restart n8n
scripts._comment_docker: Run the tooling inside the stack's image, so nothing is needed on the host. npm is the entrypoint, hence 'run <script>'.
scripts.docker:bootstrap: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm tools run db:bootstrap
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm tools run db:seed
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm tools run db:reset
scripts.docker:verify: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm tools run verify
scripts.docker:smoke: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm tools run smoke
scripts._comment_disk: Vigor's own footprint, and what is safe to reclaim. See docs/07-docker-and-storage.md before pruning.
scripts.docker:backfill: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/docker-compose.yml --profile tools run --rm tools run metrics:backfill
